title: Create Diesel Compat (IE Diesel Generator)
description: Makes Create: Diesel Generator Diesel and Biodiesel Compatible in the Immersive engineering Diesel Generator
body:
Lets Create: Diesel Generators' diesel and biodiesel fluids can now power the Immersive Engineering Diesel Generator.

Diesel burns at 285 burn time, matching Immersive Engineering's Sulfurized Diesel.

Biodiesel burns at 250 burn time, matching Immersive Engineering's Biodiesel.
